newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dong Yang seeks approval for merger.
newsitem.headline: Dong Yang seeks approval for merger.

text.p: South Korea's Dong Yang Tinplate Co Ltd would seek approval of its plan to absorb its unlisted affiliate Dong Yang Metal Printing Co Ltd at a shareholder meeting on Tuesday, the Korea Securities Depository said on Monday.
A depository statement said the absorption plan was being opposed by shareholders owning 25.19 percent of Dong Yang Tinplate shares, but gave no details.
Shareholders opposing the absorption may offer to sell their shares to the company within 20 days after shareholders approve the plan, the statement said.
The merger was aimed at improving competitiveness of the two companies which are now engaged in similar businesses, a Dong Yang Tinplate official said.
